title: iria neilsonii
intro: Iria neilsonii, commonly known as the Iria or Iri, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which help in treating conditions such as fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Iria neilsonii include analgesia, antipyresis, and anti-edema effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Iria neilsonii plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
